$comment: Policy for the autonomous issue-to-merge loop. See docs/loop-engineering.md.
This file is the single source of truth for risk classification and retry
limits. It is deliberately data, not code: a reviewer can audit the whole
merge policy by reading one file. It lives under .github/, which is itself
classified high risk, so changing the policy always requires human approval.
